strategy_roster.name: BHS System
strategy_roster.notes: Reference strategy is not expressible as a deterministic single-security OHLCV entry signal in the TASI DSL; a never-true guard is used rather than fabricating a signal. Unsupported schedule, portfolio, order-management, external-data, or multi-order mechanics are not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Cryptocurrency Fibonacci MAs (StockSharp)
strategy_roster.notes: MACD-based reference translated to the local MACD 12/26/9-style DSL using documented periods where available; unsupported platform-specific filters/order handling are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Lego V3
strategy_roster.notes: Stochastic is approximated from the close position within the 14-bar high/low range because the DSL has no dedicated stochastic function.

strategy_roster.name: Moving Averages
strategy_roster.notes: Moving-average reference translated with inferred/default periods 10/30; unsupported shifts, recursive state, or execution rules are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Volume Weighted Price Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Donchian/breakout reference translated with prior-bar 20-bar channel bounds to avoid current-bar look-ahead. Additional unsupported stateful filters are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Crossing Moving Average
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using current-period ATR relative to its rolling average; absolute price-step risk controls are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: EMA WMA RSI
strategy_roster.notes: Williams %R is expressed from the rolling high/low range using the DSL primitives; vendor-specific smoothing/state is omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Mikul's Ichimoku Cloud v2
strategy_roster.notes: Donchian/breakout reference translated with prior-bar 14-bar channel bounds to avoid current-bar look-ahead. Additional unsupported stateful filters are omitted.

strategy_roster.name: Dynamic Dots Dashboard
strategy_roster.notes: Ichimoku is approximated with a fast/slow EMA cloud-direction proxy because native Ichimoku components are not in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: MA Envelopes
strategy_roster.notes: ATR/volatility reference translated using current-period ATR relative to its rolling average; absolute price-step risk controls are omitted.
